title: glechoma agrestis
intro: Glechoma agrestis, commonly known as Creeping Jenny or Wild Chamomile, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and promoting relaxation due to its health benefits, such as calming the nervous system and soothing digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Glechoma agrestis are primarily attributed to its sedative and antispasmodic properties, which help to relieve anxiety, insomnia, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and provide antioxidant and antimicrobial effects.
